name: Katerina Novakova
bio:
Katerina's motorsport journey began unexpectedly during her engineering studies in Prague. A chance encounter with a local karting team sparked an immediate fascination with the technical intricacies and strategic demands of racing. She quickly transitioned from an observer to an active participant, volunteering her skills to optimize kart performance and improve team logistics. This hands-on experience laid the foundation for her career.

Prior to joining the Kart Academy, Katerina honed her operational expertise in the automotive industry, managing production lines and implementing efficiency improvements. She brings a data-driven approach to her role, meticulously analyzing performance metrics and identifying areas for optimization. Her leadership style emphasizes collaboration and empowerment, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the team. Katerina's ability to blend technical knowledge with strong organizational skills makes her an invaluable asset, driving the Kart Academy toward peak performance.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a low ponytail with a few strands framing her face.
physical.description: Katerina is a woman of average height with a thoughtful expression and a confident demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with optimization ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every Monday with a team-wide brainstorming session.
